column3: “Upon yourself” replaces “upon it,” referring to the left side.
The repeated “a day for a year” is shortened.
“Dried” is added to the human excrement.
“By wild beasts” specifies what tore the animal.
“Cut off the supply of food” replaces breaking the staff of bread; “despair” replaces horror.
The appalled reaction and wasting away are joined as appalled observation of one another wasting away.
